rows.label: TITLE
rows.clue: A heading that names a statute or legislative bill

rows.label: MODIFIER
rows.clue: A content word that qualifies the meaning of a noun or verb

rows.label: TOKEN
rows.clue: An individual instance of a type of symbol

rows.label: APOLOGY
rows.clue: An expression of regret at having caused trouble for someone

rows.label: VERSE
rows.clue: Literature in metrical form

rows.label: BANNING
rows.clue: An official prohibition or edict against something

rows.label: ALPHA
rows.clue: The 1st letter of the Greek alphabet

rows.label: BAN
rows.clue: A decree that prohibits something

rows.label: EDITION
rows.clue: The form in which a text (especially a printed book) is published

rows.label: DISCO
rows.clue: Popular dance music (especially in the late 1970s)

rows.label: RHETORIC
rows.clue: Using language effectively to please or persuade

rows.label: QUOTE
rows.clue: A punctuation mark used to attribute the enclosed text to someone else

rows.label: DIATRIBE
rows.clue: Thunderous verbal attack

rows.label: BREVITY
rows.clue: The use of brief expressions

rows.label: OBLIQUE
rows.clue: Any grammatical case other than the nominative

rows.label: BULLETIN
rows.clue: A brief report (especially an official statement issued for immediate publication or broadcast)

rows.label: SPLURGE
rows.clue: An ostentatious display (of effort or extravagance etc.)

rows.label: OVERVIEW
rows.clue: A general summary of a subject

rows.label: PUZZLE
rows.clue: A particularly baffling problem that is said to have a correct solution

rows.label: PROMISE
rows.clue: A verbal commitment by one person to another agreeing to do (or not to do) something in the future

rows.label: TICKET
rows.clue: A commercial document showing that the holder is entitled to something (as to ride on public transportation or to enter a public entertainment)

rows.label: SECRET
rows.clue: Something that should remain hidden from others (especially information that is not to be passed on)

rows.label: TOME
rows.clue: A (usually) large and scholarly book

rows.label: RESPECTS
rows.clue: (often used with `pay') a formal expression of esteem

rows.label: DEMERIT
rows.clue: A mark against a person for misconduct or failure

rows.label: NUMERAL
rows.clue: A symbol used to represent a number

rows.label: BLUE JOKE
rows.clue: An indelicate joke

rows.label: FILM
rows.clue: A form of entertainment that enacts a story by sound and a sequence of images giving the illusion of continuous movement

rows.label: RECALL
rows.clue: A request by the manufacturer of a defective product to return the product (as for replacement or repair)

rows.label: PEDANTRY
rows.clue: An ostentatious and inappropriate display of learning

rows.label: COPY
rows.clue: A reproduction of a written record (e.g. of a legal or school record)

rows.label: POUT
rows.clue: A disdainful grimace

rows.label: COMEDY
rows.clue: Light and humorous drama with a happy ending

rows.label: PLUS SIGN
rows.clue: A sign indicating the operation of addition

rows.label: PEN NAME
rows.clue: An author's pseudonym

rows.label: PLEADING
rows.clue: (law) a statement in legal and logical form stating something on behalf of a party to a legal proceeding

rows.label: PAGE
rows.clue: One side of one leaf (of a book or magazine or newspaper or letter etc.) or the written or pictorial matter it contains

rows.label: DENIAL
rows.clue: The act of refusing to comply (as with a request)

rows.label: LANGUAGE
rows.clue: A systematic means of communicating by the use of sounds or conventional symbols

rows.label: GRAPHICS
rows.clue: Photographs or other visual representations in a printed publication

rows.label: WHOOP
rows.clue: A loud hooting cry of exultation or excitement

rows.label: BANTER
rows.clue: Light teasing repartee

rows.label: ADVISORY
rows.clue: An announcement that usually advises or warns the public of some threat

rows.label: PATENT
rows.clue: A document granting an inventor sole rights to an invention

rows.label: AFFIX
rows.clue: A linguistic element added to a word to produce an inflected or derived form

rows.label: CHART
rows.clue: A visual display of information

rows.label: PASTORAL
rows.clue: A musical composition that evokes rural life

rows.label: TUTORIAL
rows.clue: A session of intensive tuition given by a tutor to an individual or to a small number of students

rows.label: PAGING
rows.clue: Calling out the name of a person (especially by a loudspeaker system)

rows.label: AXIOM
rows.clue: A saying that is widely accepted on its own merits

rows.label: FOGHORN
rows.clue: A loud low warning signal that can be heard by fogbound ships

rows.label: PLAY LIST
rows.clue: A list of musical selections for performance or for broadcast by radio

rows.label: METAPHOR
rows.clue: A figure of speech in which an expression is used to refer to something that it does not literally denote in order to suggest a similarity

rows.label: EMBARGO
rows.clue: A government order imposing a trade barrier

rows.label: OLD STYLE
rows.clue: A typeface (based on an 18th century design) distinguished by irregularity and slanted ascender serifs and little contrast between light and heavy strokes

rows.label: SIGN
rows.clue: A perceptible indication of something not immediately apparent (as a visible clue that something has happened)

rows.label: FLATTERY
rows.clue: Excessive or insincere praise

rows.label: ALBUM
rows.clue: One or more recordings issued together

rows.label: HANDBOOK
rows.clue: A concise reference book providing specific information about a subject or location

rows.label: INFIX
rows.clue: An affix that is inserted inside the word

rows.label: STANDARD
rows.clue: A basis for comparison

rows.label: TARGET
rows.clue: A reference point to shoot at

rows.label: DISPLAY
rows.clue: Something intended to communicate a particular impression

rows.label: JOT
rows.clue: A brief (and hurriedly handwritten) note

rows.label: FICTION
rows.clue: A literary work based on the imagination and not necessarily on fact

rows.label: DEBUGGER
rows.clue: A program that helps in locating and correcting programming errors

rows.label: DANCE
rows.clue: An artistic form of nonverbal communication

rows.label: JABBER
rows.clue: Rapid and indistinct speech

rows.label: NOTATION
rows.clue: A technical system of symbols used to represent special things

rows.label: FILM CLIP
rows.clue: A strip of motion picture film used in a telecast

rows.label: RUBRIC
rows.clue: An authoritative rule of conduct or procedure

rows.label: ASKING
rows.clue: The verbal act of requesting

rows.label: RECAP
rows.clue: A summary at the end that repeats the substance of a longer discussion

rows.label: THRILLER
rows.clue: A suspenseful adventure story or play or movie

rows.label: TITLE BAR
rows.clue: (computer science) a horizontal label at the top of a window, bearing the name of the currently active document

rows.label: GRIMACE
rows.clue: A contorted facial expression

rows.label: DRAWL
rows.clue: A slow speech pattern with prolonged vowels

rows.label: SHOWDOWN
rows.clue: A hostile disagreement face-to-face

rows.label: EXCERPT
rows.clue: A passage selected from a larger work

rows.label: CHAT
rows.clue: An informal conversation

rows.label: CONCERTO
rows.clue: A composition for orchestra and a soloist

rows.label: ALLUSION
rows.clue: Passing reference or indirect mention

rows.label: INSIGNIA
rows.clue: A badge worn to show official position

rows.label: PEDAL
rows.clue: A sustained bass note

rows.label: POSTMARK
rows.clue: A cancellation mark stamped on mail by postal officials

rows.label: CHANNEL
rows.clue: A path over which electrical signals can pass

rows.label: WARNING
rows.clue: A message informing of danger

rows.label: CAPTION
rows.clue: Taking exception

rows.label: VOCAL
rows.clue: Music intended to be performed by one or more singers, usually with instrumental accompaniment

rows.label: CHANNELS
rows.clue: Official routes of communication

rows.label: HOOF MARK
rows.clue: A visible impression on a surface made by the hoof of an animal

rows.label: RAP
rows.clue: A reproach for some lapse or misdeed

rows.label: LIGATURE
rows.clue: (music) a group of notes connected by a slur

rows.label: EULOGY
rows.clue: A formal expression of praise for someone who has died recently

rows.label: NAME
rows.clue: A language unit by which a person or thing is known

rows.label: INDENT
rows.clue: An order for goods to be exported or imported
